decision: Do not add or infer an upper-floor model. The reviewed architect publication supplies an orthographic ground-floor plan and building sections, but no upper-floor plan. The official visitor narrative and the 2026 accessibility guide document upstairs collections without room geometry.

routeNodes.note: All existing guide route nodes are preserved. Only the cloister stop remains bound to documented ground-floor geometry.

sourcesReviewed.finding: The official current route describes the ground-floor sequence, the upper-floor liturgical collections, the upper loggia, and return to the cloister. It contains no plan, room boundaries, dimensions, or room-number diagram.
Page 3 is explicitly labelled 'pianta piano terra e sezioni'. It contains one ground-floor orthographic plan plus sections; no upper-floor orthographic plan appears anywhere in the four-page PDF.

Page 75 documents current upper-floor content including the Burgundian Christ, Giovanni Pisano ivory Madonna, illuminated manuscripts, Exultet rolls, cafe, and terrace. The guide contains a city itinerary map but no museum floor plan.
Project credits, area, and photographs document the renovation but supply no downloadable upper-floor plan.

The project text confirms two storeys, a new connecting stair, 3,000 square metres, and 26 display sections. Its attached PDF is the four-page project publication already reviewed and does not include the upper plan.
